title: nODD ECAL layouts - reviewer overview
subtitle: Si-W and ALLEGRO LAr candidates. Review entry, not a TDR.

blocks.text: Both candidates retain the documented tracker (45,646 sensitive planes) and the proposed inner solenoid (3 T central target; [PR #64](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/64), open). Its radial service reservation reaches 1.64 m; the computed vessel ends at r=1.559 m and |z|=3.85 m. These DRAFT prototypes have no complete-detector, installed-field or engineering acceptance.

blocks.text: Open component proposals: [PR #71](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/71) (Si-W ECAL barrel prototype) and [PR #70](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/70) (Si-W ECAL endcap prototype). The same sampling and board stack is carried through sixteen barrel sectors and sixteen wedge carriers per endcap.

rows: 48 layers; 1.9 mm tungsten alloy and 0.5 mm silicon. Standard 90 mm blanks have an 88 mm active window and 5.5 mm pad pitch; physical guards remain passive.
Seven 1 m slabs plus two short end slabs per sector/layer. Alternating ±96 mm shifts move service joints through depth; 94 mm boards on a 96 mm pitch retain real gaps.
76 squares plus 36 custom edge sensors per wedge/layer; 29 mask profiles. The 100 mm aperture apothem, 30 mm inner support and 120 mm outer service bay are unsigned allocations.
Aluminium skins and frames, explicit PCB/ASIC/thermal contacts; a 3 mm copper plate with 2 mm-OD Ti/water runs. External collectors, connectors and cable routing are excluded.

blocks.text: Recorded model masses are 299.003 t for the barrel and 98.949 t for both endcaps. Copper contributes 119.693/40.591 t, dominated by the cooling plates. Continuous heat hypotheses give 188.40/71.05 kW; the summed ideal water flow is 12.414 kg/s for a 5 K rise. These are inventory/power calculations, not thermal or hydraulic qualification.

Barrel active-face area is 54.88-64.57% by layer; aligned sector-centre cracks remain. Custom masks give 69.47% endcap active-face area. At η=4, 68.89% of 360 one-degree-centred azimuth rays cross active silicon in at least one endcap layer; seams and guards leave blind directions. Native construction, IDs, mass and overlap checks plus sparse saved hits establish the isolated implementation; efficiencies and showers remain unvalidated.

Open component proposals: [PR #73](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/73) (LAr ECAL barrel and service interfaces prototype) and [PR #74](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/74) (LAr ECAL endcaps and layout prototype). The separate inner 3 T coil is retained; ALLEGRO’s outer-solenoid proxy is omitted.

rows: 1,536 inclined periods, eleven compartments, two active gaps per electrode. Sampling radii 2.1728-2.5783 m; active half-length 3.910 m. Pb core 1.8 mm, total steel/glue 0.2/0.1 mm and 1.2 mm PCB; first core is passive LAr.

Three wheels, 384/720/1,360 periods, 49° tilt, active r=410-2,790 mm and 450 mm depth. Inner Pb core 1.1 mm, total steel/glue 0.2/0.1 mm and 1.3 mm electrode. Radial/axial readout is virtual, distinct from source calibration subdivisions.

Sixteen barrel H-rings and 5,888 wet board slots. Each endcap has three wheel support tubes, a 30 mm rear annulus (1.954 t/end) and 1,584 board slots. The unported rear annulus blocks direct signal/HV routes; passages and attachments need redesign.

Explicit warm/vacuum/cold wall proxies, 170 mm barrel rear bath and 250 mm endcap rear bath. N2 branches have 18 mm bore/20 mm OD; headers, seals, pressure/temperature and return-circuit qualification remain open.

blocks.text: The model has 2.286 million barrel cells and 601,600 per endcap. The Cartesian turbine taper differs from cylindrical-radius intent by up to 0.117 mm in the inner wheel. Physical mass includes bath displacement and cold service proxies. A 200 kW cooling allowance falls 58 kW short of the 258 kW adverse planning scenario, before complete static-heat qualification.

Native component checks and the ECAL-only combined audit do not qualify the tracker/coil/HCAL union. LAr remains uncovered at η=4; forward reservations contain no hardware. Barrel/endcap transition directions have partial depth, requiring later material/response design.

blocks.text: ECAL masses are native-ledger sums with different passive/service hypotheses; shared tracker/solenoid, detailed HCAL and absent systems are excluded. Aluminium totals include walls, supports and boards. Masses do not rank performance. HCAL outline volume grows ×1.77; loads and magnetic effects remain unvalidated.

Shared tracker+Be inventory: 2.860 t (Be 2.036 kg); planning region r≤1.20 m, |z|≤3.60 m does not bound passive services. At η=0, separate examples are tracker 0.329-0.418 X0 and illustrative solenoid 1.402 X0 (1.00-2.10 scenarios). These are not a combined pre-ECAL map. Solenoid mass/support inventory remains unassigned. [Solenoid material assumptions](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/4e44d7c650ac0a2931f7fc1637b5b3f2dfbe4c95/docs/validation/DES-026/material-estimate.md).

Review the Si-W copper/cooling choice, manifold endpoints, seams and custom-mask process; review LAr vessel/support approximations, blocked service paths, spare-board power and cryogenic heat margin. Confirm space/interface ownership before detailed HCAL work. Forward acceptance, shielding and the machine/beam-pipe continuation need a separate design. No FCal or muon system/magnets are yet implemented.

All four component PRs remain open in this 2026-10-14 snapshot. Dimensions/services are unsigned nODD choices; native budgets are model inferences. Recorded checks grant no engineering sign-off, installed field or shower/jet/particle-flow validation. This brief is a common review entry; the pinned component records remain authoritative.
